common_repair_time_oracle.source: existing Codeflaws repair-test input and expected-output pairs

evidence_groups.A: buggy source plus common repair-time oracle
evidence_groups.B: A plus frozen FL-v1 Top-10 locations
evidence_groups.C: B plus runtime-only verdict, actual stdout/stderr, exit code, and timeout

fl_availability_rule.inputs: FL-v1 ranking only; no ground truth or reference data
fl_availability_rule.no_reliable_message: No reliable suspicious location is available from FL-v1.
fl_availability_rule.reliable: ranking is non-empty and maximum line suspiciousness is positive

patch_classification.plausible_patch: compile success and all repair tests pass
patch_classification.validated_patch: plausible and all hidden validation tests pass
